literal_facts: The June 19 city article identifies the DC BLOX cable landing station in Town Center as currently under construction, limited to one approved building.
The city's project hub explicitly gives colocation capabilities and links the exact approved plan under 1109 Town Center Blvd and permit 2025100821.
The older approved plan labels GUMBO, 1035 Town Center Blvd, parent parcel 0070 and the first-building site as Lot 7B; its adjoining Lot 7A is not the approved first-building site.

The current official address point at 1109 identifies parcel 0071, whose exact official legal description calls it Lot 7B. The selected stored-source HARN point lies within that parcel after explicit transformations; the service's NAD83 address response also passes a same-CRS containment cross-check.
identity_chain.analyst_reconciliation: The city's current plan-link address and GIS lot/address facts reconcile an older parent-address design to the subdivided approved first-building parcel. This is an explicit cross-record association, not a claim that the June 19 article literally contains coordinates or parcel IDs.

scope_caveats: The city's approved CLS explicitly has colocation capabilities. No AI or hyperscale claim is selected.
One approved first building only; adjacent Lot 7A, an unapproved second building and any future expansion create no selected site or project.

The approved plan has the historical 1035/0070 parent address while the city's current download label and exact GIS point/parcel use 1109/0071 Lot 7B. This reconciliation is explicit, not silently assumed.

The older approved plan totals 34,875 square feet (34,823 main plus 52 guard) versus 33,760 in the June 19 city statement. The discrepancy's cause is unresolved; no area or other metric is normalized.
Plan approval November 12, 2025 is an approval date, not its unknown publication date or the selected construction observation.

The address layer's stored sourceSpatialReference is EPSG:2881; service/extent and earlier query response are EPSG:2236. Final selection starts from the exact 2881 source-CRS query. Earlier 2236 and server 4326 routes remain unselected coordinate audits.
Map item terms warn of generalized error, published-scale limits and survey differences. This minimal factual locator is not an open-license or site-survey claim.

successor_review.finding: The city June 19 statement establishes actual current construction. The July 2 city follow-up and its current June-record project hub retain a single approved building and future approval requirements. Bounded exact-campus searches found no authoritative completion or cancellation that supersedes the observation.
successor_review.unselected_context: County-level moratorium reporting was screened but is not treated as cancellation of this city-approved project. Search snippets and owner marketing are not selected as lifecycle evidence; no claim about legal moratorium applicability is normalized.
